notes.title: Decision to Postpone Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Today I made the decision with a heavy heart to postpone the planned release to October 2025.[/h3]

As the initially planned release date approached fast, I felt the pressure rising to ship [b]CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134[/b] in a state I would consider finished, but not reflecting the true potential I see in it.

While the content of the game should be ready around the time I initially planned to release, there is still more I can do to [b]improve and polish[/b] in significant ways.

Thanks to your awesome feedback in the several past months I really found out in what direction I should push the game and some [b]features got added[/b] to the previously already far advanced project. I want to give you the best game CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 can be. And that unfortunately takes me longer than I anticipated.

I want to apologize for not keeping the schedule and I hope you stick with me a few more months until I will release the absolute best version of the game in [b]October 2025[/b].

[h3]I'll try to keep you informed about the game’s state at all times.[/h3]
I also just started a devlog video series on the FiendGames YouTube channel, where you can follow the development and get some exclusive insights into the process of creating CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134. 
[b]
Take care and see you soon![/b]
Gabriel Mittermair
Fiend Games
